name: atx-sjc-2026-09 — Austin → San Jose, planned (Kris, 2026-09-01)
_notes: RWGPS-import shape: one LineString feature per Leg (in order), Point features per Checkpoint/Sight.
Go: seed/<slug>.geojson on first boot, the EagleLakeRocks pattern.

Coordinates are planning-grade (town centroids, ~1 km) until a checkpoint is arrived at, when the app overwrites its point with where the car actually stopped and marks it precision=exact — unless it is precision=fuzzed, which stays on the grid.

Night 3 was Bridgeport, CA (2026-09-06), not Mammoth Lakes; legs 3 and 4 were re-pointed to match. The terminus is a private residence in Menlo Park: precision=fuzzed, its point is already the 0.05° grid cell, and leg 4's last vertex is that same cell.
Timezones move westbound: CDT (TX) → MDT (NM) → MST no-DST (AZ) → PDT (NV/CA). Every checkpoint carries its own tz.
kind=candidate Sights are suggestions only — prune, they are not commitments.

Origin is public-safe: checkpoint 1 is 'Hudson Bend (home)', precision=fuzzed, and both its pin and the first vertex of leg 1 are snapped to the 0.05° grid. The app re-snaps any precision=fuzzed checkpoint at render time and never shows street text for it.

Private text (a lodging street address) lives in $DATA_DIR/private.json on the volume — {"checkpoints": {"<ord>": {"address": "…"}}} — never in this file or this repo; the app renders it on admin pages only. Any checkpoint with precision=fuzzed is snapped to the 0.05° grid on render. Planning data (legs, checkpoints not yet arrived, candidate sights) is refreshed from this seed on every boot; arrived checkpoints, posts and photos are never touched.
